steps.assistant_text: IDENTIFIED: libultra __osLeoInterrupt (io/leointerrupt.c verbatim, 2.0-era 64DD LEO layout). The old NM wrap's 'caller-set $t6 structural cap' was a stolen-prologue misread: the 2-word orphan at 0x6B0F4 (lui/lw $t6) is the function's __osDiskHandle load (6B7A0/6B798 precedent). Wrap decode mapped 1:1: 0x1D/0x16/0x17/0x18/4 err codes = LEO_ERROR_29/22/23/24/4; jal 0x7FEEC/0x7FE04 = __osLeoResume/__osLeoAbnormalResume; blank jal = osEPiRawStartDma (gl_func_0006F8A4); blockNum*0x24 = __OSBlockInfo stride; 0x100401 = OS_IM_PI; 0x40000000 = LEO_STATUS_DATA_REQUEST. IDO 5.3 -O1 donor, 425/425 words exact on FIRST compile (incl. absorbed prologue). Layout gotcha: a lone 1-word pad INCLUDE_ASM emits 2 words; fold the leading alignment nop into the preceding bzero .s tail instead.
